author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: scan_en only selects functional data. The reset releases through a two-stage chain on clk, and the false path names no reset root.

author_reading.rationale: scan_en is a static functional-mode select outside the reset path; the reset chain is a plain two-stage release on clk.

labels.rationale: rst_sync is a 2-stage synchroniser from rst_n on clk, and q is released by it. scan_en is a data mux select, not a reset, and its false path does not touch any reset root.
The scan select affects functional data only. The exception on that select creates no reset release path, and reset releases through a two-stage chain.
labels.suspected_flaw: The scan select has no timing or static-mode contract for its separate functional data path.

settlement.rationale: Both readers judge good. The class follows B and the author (the false-path lookalike); A's crossing class does not fit.
